full_judgment:
3. The main ground on which the defendant No. 1 entered the contest was that the plaintiff was not entitled to recover rent from the defendants inasmuch as his interest, being that of a "lent receiver", within the meaning of sub-section (23) of section 2 of the East Bengal State Acquisition and Tenancy Act 1950, hereinafter referred to as the said Act, had vested in the Government under provisions of the said Act. 

 "The definition of "rent-receiver" and "khasland" kept the interest of the landlord letting out land together with building and necessary adjuncts thereto, otherwise than in perpetuity, outside the mischief of acquisition" 

 For the reason stated above the appeal is dismissed. The judgment and decree of the Appellate Court below are affirmed. There will be no order as to costs.
